QcMetricsFacet.description: Open-ended named QC metrics, e.g. from a MultiQC report. One instance per (tool, sample, metric) - attach several to the same DataFile/AnalysisRun rather than inventing one big combined shape.

metric_name.description: Prefer a CURIE from OpenNGS's datapoint vocabulary (schema/vocabularies/datapoints.yaml, e.g. openngs-dp:percent_duplication) when the metric matches a known concept there - see the guide's "Making fields comparable across facets" section. Fall back to a producer-scoped raw string (e.g. fastqc:duplicate_percentage) otherwise.

sample_name.description: The sample identifier as reported by the QC tool, before any identity reconciliation.

tool.description: The tool that produced this metric, e.g. fastqc, samtools, star.
